title: What "I'm a Mighty Tight Woman" means
summary: She explains the title as being tight in everything she does and devoted to a man.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: What does that mean, "I'm a Mighty Tight Woman?" What does that mean?

The man said to me, see, what that means, I say that means I'm tight in everything I do. I'm tight in everything I do, everything I do. If __________ be your slave, I'll be your slave. I could do anything you want me to do if you __________ me. See? I'm a mighty tight woman.
That's beautiful poetry. You know, your songs are beautiful poetry.
